feat(OP-07): let the broker bind explicit exits to pending market entries

Do not reject a command from the pre-callback open-entry snapshot: a preceding entry in the same committed intent batch can supply the target. Keep unsupported trailing, all-entry and v6 mixed-level checks. The broker rejects pending price-entry activation until continuous segments are supported.
